_about: Env variables that ai/bin/check-machine-secrets probes (a) and (b) do not report although their NAME matches a credential name (DND-845). Exact names only: no wildcard, and in particular no CLAUDE_CODE_* pattern (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is a real credential). An entry is honoured only once it has LANDED on origin/main: ai/contracts/athena-machine-secrets.md -> The env allowlist.
